messages:
Elaine (CEO): Quick heads-upwe're holding a 45-minute all-hands this Friday at 9:30am PT. Please join on Zoom or watch the stream. Agenda below; drop questions here or use the anonymous form. Recording + slides posted after.

Agenda: 
- Redwood Optimize public beta: staging->prod rollout plan and what teams must verify
- Policy tweak: default audit log retention shortened for trial orgs (details + opt-out)
- Incident summary: last week's multi-region inference latency spike and safeguards
- Dedicated: new onboarding checklist and customer-facing timing
- Org update: two IC promotions + hiring priorities
- Live Q&A (we'll take 10 main Qs then quick follow-ups)

Pre-reads & Qs: https://forms.gle/redwood-allhands-questions-2101119999
Recording placeholder: https://redwood.company/recordings/2101119999

Ravi (VP Eng): Heads-up  I have a calendar conflict 9:30-9:40. Can the exec update be frontloaded into the first 8 minutes?

Elaine (CEO): Yesexec updates first 8mins, then product + ops. We'll start right on time.

Priya (Product): I'll add a slide with SDK compatibility notes and known quota impacts. Deck will be in the shared folder by Thu EOD.

Noah (SRE): For the incident recap, I'll attach a 1-slide timeline + concrete mitigations. Postmortem draft will be in incidents channel by Thu for comments.

Maya (Ops): Ops will need 3 minutes to call out Dedicated customer action items. I'll include a quick checklist and the list of accounts needing manual check.

Tess (Comms): Planning the internal blurb and partner-safe summary after the meeting. If anything is embargoed, DM me.

Ravi (VP Eng): Also is there going to be a town-hall style live captioning? Last time it helped APAC folks.

calendar-bot: Event created: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/2101119999  includes Zoom + stream + captions enabled.

Elaine (CEO): Perfect. If you want a question prioritized live mark it URGENT in the form or tag me in this thread. We'll prioritize product + ops questions.

Priya (Product): Adding two short demos in the notes: latency telemetry and cache improvements.

Noah (SRE): Root cause summary for the spike: autoscaling interplay + a throttled networking path in one region. Short-term: tuned autoscaler thresholds and temporary routing change. Long-term: improved anomaly detection + simulated load tests.

Maya (Ops): If you own a Dedicated customer impacted by the spike, please add the account ID to the incident post so we can confirm remediation before Friday.

Ravi (VP Eng): If I miss the live slot I'll supply a 90s recording of the perf graphs for Elaine to play.

Elaine (CEO): Thankswe're trialing a tightened Q&A: 10 live questions, 5 followups. If we can't finish we'll compile answers in this thread & post an FAQ.

Tess (Comms): Deck link (Thu): https://notion.redwood.com/allhands/2101119999-deck

Ravi (VP Eng): :thumbsup:

Elaine (CEO): See you Friday. Keep this thread for Qs/pre-reads only; move incident chatter to #incidents.
